title: D4 component (d4/v1)
description: One component.yaml per component (apps/*, packages/*, infra/*), read by run/run.sh. run/orchestrator/components.ts enforces the same rules.

envLayers.description: Values for every runtime (common) and per runtime (local, podman). ${VAR}, ${VAR:-default} and ${VAR:?message} interpolate from run/env, host.conf and derived values (D4_PUBLIC_URL, PORT_<NAME>, ...).

category.description: Selectable as a group: run.sh <runtime>:<category>:<command>. tool: run once (exec, test), no long-running process.

optional.description: Left out of `stack`; started only when named (or by category/group).

dependsOn.description: Started before this one; their `provides` flow into this one's settings.

source.description: The workspace package built with turbo (@d4/api).

ports.description: Ports on 127.0.0.1 (host network), the same in every runtime. The first one (or health.port) is the component's address. A value may be ${KEY} from host.conf.

http.description: Path probed on the main port (local runtime, and in the container with wget unless cmd is set).

cmd.description: Shell command run inside the container (podman healthcheck run, every 5 s while starting).

route.description: The path the gateway serves it at (shown by status).

provides.description: Settings given to every component that depends on this one (addresses, secrets directories).

sharedEnv.description: Start from run/env/common.env and the secrets (default: true, false for infra).

command.description: Shell command run from the repository root, detached, with the merged settings.

build.description: deps (default): compile the workspace dependencies, the command builds the package itself (watch); full: compile the package too.

via.description: Served by another component's container (the web modules: ui-modules).

image.description: A published image, pinned in run/env/images.env (${POSTGRES_IMAGE}).

artifact.description: What goes into app/ of the build context: node (pnpm deploy --prod), static (dist/), modules (dist/ of each component served via this one), files (only build.files), none.

postStart.description: Tools run after it is healthy (and again when their image changes).

e2e.description: The browser specs covering this component (apps/e2e/tests/...).
